defect_ledger.title: Duplicate shadowing switch cases in canvas-element.tsx
defect_ledger.description: Six duplicate switch cases (price_table, icon_list, image_box, price_list, toggle, hotspot) cause unreachable dead code and silent props divergence.

defect_ledger.title: Price Table feature availability and strike-through parity
defect_ledger.description: Features with available: false must render strike-through and dash symbol instead of active checkmark.

defect_ledger.title: Accordion default_open false override bug
defect_ledger.description: First accordion item forced open even when default_open is explicitly false.

defect_ledger.title: Flip box button navigation prevention in canvas edit mode
defect_ledger.description: Flip box back button clicks in iframe trigger navigation when not in preview mode.
